row_check.notes: conditions and ca_measure correctly empty: no moderators are tested (complementary assets explicitly deferred to future research, p.15) and no CA construct appears anywhere — the study is pure productivity econometrics. Adjudication brief confirms AI intensity is an alternative treatment measure, not a condition. Two author-side observations: (1) coded performance_measure says 'labor- and value-added-based' but the paper's own wording is 'sales-based and valueadded-based productivity measures' (p.2) — the sales-based production-function measure, not labor productivity per se; (2) evaluative parts of quality_notes ('one of the methodically strongest positive findings') are coder commentary — source-based parts (representative survey, IV strategy, 2.5/20 average intensity, one-country/short-panel limits) are quoted.
